What to record: Identify the project, room, assembly, finish schedule, and active revision.
Record applicator, inspector, or handoff owner plus the relevant date.
Identify substrate, product, color, sheen, lot, and current instructions.
Record approved sample, specification, manufacturer sheet, drawing, or signed standard.
Record final installed scope, as-built revision, omitted or transferred items, and archive location.
Record ordered, used, returned, retained offcuts, scrap, remakes, and comparable yield basis.
Record planned and actual values plus named causes for meaningful differences.
Record one supported process update, owner, due date, and documents or templates affected.
Example: Add final wall check / PM / template v3
